title: Color the Grid: How Many Ways? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Nine squares, three colors, and the center is already red. Neighbors can't match, so how many colorings are there? Vantee counts them by sorting the edge squares first, then double-checks by counting non-red corners, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you a 2 by 3 grid to try yourself.
